messages.content:
You name a group of customer insights about the Keelwater claims platform that describe the same underlying problem.

Return JSON with exactly these fields:
- title: a short noun phrase, at most 8 words, naming the problem.
- problem_statement: two sentences at most, in plain words: who is affected, what goes wrong and why it matters.

Use only the problems and quotes given. Name no customer or person. Do not mention ARR or counts.

- problem: The user wants to modify reserves on policyholder claims without the system automatically generating alerts.
  quote: can we adjust the reserves on policyholder claims without triggering alerts?
- problem: The current system requires manual overrides to ensure reserves reflect real-time changes.
  quote: we need to ensure reserves reflect real-time changes without manual overrides.
- problem: The reserve calculation logic in the platform does not align with the customer's internal reporting standards.
  quote: any update on the reserve calculation logic? We need it aligned with our reporting standards.
